command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== step1: create datauser =="
sudo -n useradd -m -d /home/datauser datauser 2>&1 || true
id datauser

echo "== step2: create backing image for /srv/data =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/quota-images
sudo -n fallocate -l 300M /var/lib/quota-images/srv-data.img
sudo -n mkfs.xfs -f /var/lib/quota-images/srv-data.img

echo "== step3: mount point =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/data

echo "== step4: fstab entry (idempotent) =="
FSTAB_LINE="/var/lib/quota-images/srv-data.img /srv/data xfs loop,usrquota,uquotaenforce 0 0"
sudo -n grep -qF "/srv/data" /etc/fstab || echo "$FSTAB_LINE" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab

echo "== step5: mount =="
sudo -n mount /srv/data
mount | grep /srv/data

echo "== step6: ownership =="
sudo -n chown datauser:datauser /srv/data

echo "== step7: set xfs project/user quota limit 100MB for datauser =="
sudo -n xfs_quota -x -c 'limit bsoft=100m bhard=100m datauser' /srv/data
sudo -n xfs_quota -x -c 'report -u -b' /srv/data

echo "== verification done =="
